name: Zillow MCP
description: Searches Zillow for-sale, rental and off-market homes, compares neighborhoods, checks Zestimates and estimates affordability in Claude and ChatGPT, with no login.

skills.name: Search Homes
skills.description: Searches for-sale, for-rent and recently sold Zillow listings with the full Zillow filter set, like 3-bedroom homes under $600K.

skills.name: Compare Neighborhoods
skills.description: Compares U.S. cities or neighborhoods side by side, with for-sale and for-rent listing counts for each.

skills.name: Estimate Affordability
skills.description: Estimates the home price you can afford and breaks down a monthly payment at today's mortgage rates, including taxes, PMI and HOA.

skills.name: Look Up a Property
skills.description: Gets full details for a specific off-market home, including address, features, photos and property history.

skills.name: Check a Zestimate
skills.description: Gets a home's current Zestimate with its sale range and comparables, its Rent Zestimate, and how its Zestimate changed over time.
